correctness.rationale: The invariant square follows from boundary vector-field signs. The depleted state has invasion rate lambda(k)=1-b-(d-b)p_k(0), strictly increasing in k; b+d>2 makes q=(1-b)/(d-b)<1/2 and the positive threshold exists uniquely. The equilibrium scalar F_k(R)=1-b-(d-b)p_k(R)-R is strictly decreasing with one positive root exactly for k>kc. Its integral Lyapunov V=(d-b)(x-x*)²/2+int_R*^R(p(s)-p(R*))/s ds has positive coercive terms (diverges as R->0) and derivative -(d-b)(x-x*)²-(p(R)-p(R*))(R-R*)<0 off equilibrium, proving global convergence. For k<=kc exponential comparison yields depletion; at equality 1/R tends infinity and the exponentially weighted convolution gives e(t)/R(t)->-a with a=kc q(1-q), so (1/R)dot->kappa. Cesaro and implicit differentiation yield exact critical profile and branch slope. Checked independent exact rational-log identities and the Lyapunov derivative, not just ODE numerics.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Allee variants can exhibit bistability, while this normalized logistic (no Allee) model has a monotone equilibrium equation and a global integral Lyapunov law. General critical t^-1 dynamical phenomena do not evaluate its exact kappa or kc.
